The Industrious Spirit Company (ISCO) is Providence's first-ever distillery since Prohibition. And this boutique distillery, founded by CEO Manya K. Rubinstein, is making the world's first-ever oyster-distilled vodka. Ostreida Vodka starts as regionally-grown, organic, non-GMO corn. ISCO ferments and distills the corn in small batches and it is then combined with local oysters for the last distillation.
